abstract: Sharing economy becoming very popular at present, there are so many big service sharing companies such as Airbnb, Uber, Didi taxi and so on, and these companies have changed people's life everywhere. However, in mobile personal service sharing areas, people are still unwilling to sharing services to others. To encourage people sharing services, we based on a reputation computing method, propose a Point-to-Point service sharing model. In this model, it uses services and users information matching algorithm for precisely satisfying users' demand, then it makes users' reputation update algorithm for dynamically evaluating users'reputation. After that, a Point-to-Point service sharing platform was established, and the proposed reputation based service sharing model was achieved. Extensive experiments demonstrate that such model can improve the users' services sharing ratio and enhance their shared services quality as well.

articleTitle: Chinese A Share Stock Ranking with Machine Learning Apporach
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: How to choose stocks to make a profitable portfolio is a core question in the financial industry for stock trading. In this paper, different machine learning models are explored and compared in choosing stocks that have the highest rising probability to outperform the median return rate in Chinese A Share stock market. Random Forest achieves best performance both in predictive accuracy and annual return.

articleTitle: Prediction of leeway and drift angle based on back propagation neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the difficult problems in ship track control under wind flow conditions, and proposes a back propagation neural network based prediction method to predict in advance the rudder angle of the planned trajectory and the heading required to maintain the wind direction. Wind speed, flow direction, flow velocity, ship speed and course are input, wind pressure differential angle and pressure rudder angle are output, and the structure consists of three layers of neural network structure including input layer, hidden layer and output layer, and navigation simulator of Dalian Maritime University Maritime University. The experimental data is used to train the neural network for the sample. Finally, the actual ship data collected by MV KOTA CAHAYA is used as the actual sample for testing, and the test results are compared with the collected data. The comparison results verify the feasibility of the prediction method for the next step. The ship's track controller is designed to be prepared.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis of LC Series Resonant Bidrectional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Traditional bidirectional DC-DC converters have many problems, such as high return power, limited soft-switching range and switching off at peak current. LC series resonant DC-DC converter with inductive-capacitive resonance network has become a research hotspot. In this paper, the equivalent circuit and mathematical model of LC series resonant DAB converter are established by fundamental wave analysis method. On the basis of explaining the working principle of phase-shifting control mode in detail, the working mode of LC series resonant DC-DC converter is analyzed, the switching-off conditions of the converter are deduced, and the power transmission characteristics and soft switching characteristics of the converter under different switching-off conditions are analyzed. The simulation model is built on the simulation platform. Finally, the hardware experiment platform of the converter is built based on the TMS320F28335 and three-component lithium-ion batteries. The simulation analysis and experimental results verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Long-term Energy Efficiency Maximization for Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we study sensor-Base Station grouping management and power allocation problem for heterogeneous wireless sensor networks. We develop a stochastic optimization problem to maximize the long-term average energy efficiency. The developed optimization problem belongs to a non-convex mixed-integer program. By exploiting the fractional program, the continuity relaxation and Lagrange dual methods, the optimal solution is derived via the developed EE-based resource allocation algorithm. Simulation results validate the advantages of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Fish-swarm Algorithm Based Energy-saving Scheduling Strategy of Distributed Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the real-time energy-saving scheduling problem in multiprocessor systems, a new scheduling strategy based on artificial fish-swarm algorithm is designed. Firstly, the height values of the task nodes are defined to determine the execution order of the task nodes. The task graph is split based on the critical path, the resulting paths are assigned based on the idea of load balancing, and then the task assignment scheme is obtained. Secondly, aiming at the multiprocessor system and its energy consumption model, an effective encoding strategy is proposed to determine the voltage regulation scheme. The deadline constraint is processed based on the feasibility rules to ensure the real-time performance of the system. On this basis, the corresponding problem model is established and solved by AFSA. The simulation results show that compared with the related scheduling strategies, the application of this scheduling strategy can achieve better load balancing, and then get better energy-saving effect.

articleTitle: An Aging Face Synthesis Method Based on Feature Regions Morphing and Poisson Matting
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To meet realistic needs of retrieving lost children many years ago or catching criminals years ago, image morphing method based on Delaunay trigonometric feature region and wavelet decomposition and synthesis method were combined. Face contours were changed by image morphing method, aging textures were transferred by wavelet decomposition and synthesis method and aged face images were synthesized through Poisson matting method. Experimental results show that we can get lifelike aged images with relatively fast speed.

articleTitle: Attention-based Deep Reinforcement Learning Model for Pair-Wise Interaction Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Traditional recommendation algorithms generate a recommendation list for the user by rating prediction or ranking based on their historical record. However, most of these methods still faced with two problems: (1) only considering users' positive feedback; (2) seeking to maximize the immediate recommendation effect. To address the above issues, we propose a novel deep reinforcement learning based interactive recommendation model, named DDQN-AM. Specifically, we first use long short-term memory network to capture positive and negative interest signals from user's historical behavior as Deep Double Q-Network(DDQN)'s input states. Secondly, we also propose an attentional mechanism(AM) to learn the effects of contextual information for weight calculation. Extensive experiments on real data show that the proposed DDQN-AM model outperforms the state-of-the-art algorithms, and verify the importance of attention mechanism.

articleTitle: FaceColor: A Face Beauty Recogonition Model Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Features generated and used by traditional face recognition algorithms can be considered as shallow features, and deeper high semantic features and their depth features cannot be obtained from the original image. Based on the development of deep learning in recent years, this paper proposes a beauty recognition model, which is named as FaceColor, based on advanced convolutional neural network (CNN) .The model is based on Tensorflow framework developed by Google to match different photos' beauty features through CNN network and form a beauty feature library by expanding-algorithm. Two special research directions are designed to evaluate the ColorLibrary. Simulations and evaluations show the FaceColor can identify the quantitative level of face beauty, as the feelings of different people of different nationalities or different countries shows different appreciations of the beauty, three improved methods for ColorLibrary have been provided to make the FaceColor more suitable for strong objective applicability.

articleTitle: Review on Simulation and Modeling of Combat-oriented Communication System
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper systematically sums up the connotation, main content and extension of the communication system in the military combat simulation, describes the modeling and simulation process of the communication system, and explores the key technical requirements for the development of modeling of the communication system in combat simulation. The discussion analyzes the technical challenges faced by the modeling of communication systems in combat simulation, proposes the problems to be solved, which will provide exploration directions for future research.

articleTitle: Integral Distributed Delay Consensus of MASs With Randomly Occurring Nonlinearities and Uncertainties in Noisy Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper is mainly concerned about a distributed delay consensus problem for multi-agent systems(MASs) model with randomly occurring nonlinearities(RONs) and uncertainties(RONs) in stochastic environment. A novel general kind of integral distributed delay protocol is proposed, which is operated as a weighted integral of exchange information over previous time interval. Based on a Lyapunov function approach and Ito stochastic derivative theory, the conditions for the convergence in the mean square to achieve integral distributed delay consensus are established. Numerical examples are addressed to verify the theoretical conclusions.

articleTitle: Automatic Walnut Sorting System Based on Adaptive Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Walnut has rich nutritional value, but the nutrient content of each walnut is different, in order to distinguish them and improve the product value. In this paper, the spectrogram of walnut wavelength and absorbance was obtained by near infrared spectroscopy, and compared with the spectrogram of standard sample. The content of walnut was judged and graded. Then, the motor on the pipeline was controlled by PLC, and the sorted walnut was sent into the storage box to realize the automatic separation of walnut. By using the arithmetic structure of fuzzy control plus PID to control the running speed of pipeline, the sorting system can run fast and steadily. The results showed that walnuts were classified as unqualified walnuts below 0.5, third-class walnuts below 0.5-0.7, secondclass walnuts from 0.7-0.85, first-class walnuts from 0.85-1.0 and first-class walnuts above 1.0 by the total absorption rate of protein and fat. The detection accuracy of all walnuts reached more than 95%. This method can easily distinguish walnuts at different levels and has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis on Accuracy of Theoretical Model of Low-order Movement of Conductor
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The accurate and reasonable theoretical model of conductor vibration is one of necessary conditions for analyzing dynamics characteristics of conductor accurately. In this paper, low-order nonlinear dynamics characteristics, such as first-order natural frequency and steady state response of four-bundle and 8-bundles LGJ-500/45, has been analyzed by both theoretical (including traditional theoretical model and one in this paper) and test ways and compared to get the differences between them, which verified the validity of the conductor vibration model based on curved beam model. The result shows that the characteristics obtained from the model in this paper is more accurate that compared with the traditional model. Most importantly, conclusions in this paper provides theoretical and test basis for the further research on vibration of conductors.

articleTitle: A Multi-view Images Classification Based on Deep Graph Convolution
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Multi-view images represent the target images from different viewpoints. Reasonable use of complementary information between multiple perspective images helps to improve the accuracy of classification. We propose a novel deep spectral graph convolutional neural network (DSGC) model, extracting the deep characteristics of multi-view images via five spectral graph convolutional layers. Moreover, we propose a new method, which combines the DSGC with the ideal of [1]. The ideal of [1] regards the images of predefined views as latent variables, outputting the category probability matrix. We propose a DualFeature layer, which is used to enhance the ability to extract features. A pair of techniques batch normalization (BN) and dropout are used to improve classification performance. Experimental results show that.

articleTitle: Gravitation Search Algorithm with Two Masses for Constrained Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new gravitation search algorithm with two masses is proposed to solve constrained optimization problems. In this algorithm, each particle has two masses, namely, "feasible mass" and "infeasible mass". If the particle in the feasible region is updated, then the feasible mass is used in gravitation search algorithm, otherwise, the infeasible mass is used. This idea is based on that a feasible particle is attracted towards better feasible particles and an infeasible particle is attracted towards the feasible region. Finally, the proposed algorithm is tested on 10 benchmark problems and compared with the other algorithms. The numerical results indicate that the proposed algorithm has the better performance in solving constrained optimization problems.

articleTitle: Forecast on Failure Characteristics of Transmission Line Galloping Based on Neural Networks Method
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper conducts analysis and processing on galloping data by utilizing data mining and machine learning technology. Select the BP neural networks algorithm, establish the training model of neural networks, and then conduct forecast and early warning to galloping failure characteristics of the power transmission line. The accurate rate of forecast of the model on testing set is 89.52%. After accessing the forecast model to the galloping early warning platform for application, the line galloping accident in the eastern region of Inner Mongolia on October 26 2018 was forecasted successfully, and the forecast result of failure characteristics was output, which conformed to the actual situation, thus verifying the accuracy of model forecast result. This research achievement enhances the fining degree of galloping forecast and early warning, and the Power Grid Running and Maintenance Department can pre-judge the failure degree of galloping to the line according to galloping failure characteristics , thus adopting differentiated anti-galloping measures for solution, reducing running & maintenance cost, and enhancing the capability of power grid in dealing with galloping disaster.

articleTitle: Research on Substation Intelligent Load Transfer System Based on Panorama Data
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Substation equipments are faced with incomplete information, multiple system data cannot be effectively shared, and maintenance personnel are not aware of the status of the equipment. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a substation intelligent monitoring decision platform based on panorama data, which can realize the centralized access of substation main equipment and auxiliary equipment datas. The equipment state assessment model and intelligent load transfer decision-making base are established based on the decision platform, which realize the intelligent judgment of quantifying equipment fault and abnormal state by comprehensive evaluation method, and provide transfer strategy for substation based on device status discrimination result. Finally, The transfer strategy and model are validated by an actual engineering data, the results show that based on the method proposed in this paper, all optional load transfer schemes are formed and the best solution is given, which can improve the emergency repair and pre-control ability and have great practical value in the automation system of substation and deserves extensive application.

articleTitle: Non-interior point Newton method for semidefinite optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this report, we give an equivalent reformulation for the complementarity equation of the semidefinite optimization. By the equivalent reformulation, we present and analyze a non-interior Newton method. This method can start from an arbitrary initial matrix. We also give a simple numerical result to testify its efficiency.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Mechanism for TV Operator and Mobile Operator in TV White Space Sharing
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The shortage of spectrum resources is a critical obstacle in modern communication system, while the TV White Space (TVWS) is under exploitation with great potential. The traditional TVWS detection using Cognitive Radio (CR), without TV operator involved in, is used in a small range with power limitation and uncertainty of communication quality. In this paper, the collaborative mechanism among the TV operator, Mobile operator and users is designed and can be applied in a large range with mutual benefit and communication quality guarantee. Users use TVWS to improve the service experience and complete TVWS detection at terminals using CR technology. Then, the TV operator leases TVWS spectrum to the Mobile operator based on the TVWS detection results and the Mobile operator provides services to users using TVWS, charging for the network traffic flow. To verify the effectiveness of this mechanism, we construct the profit model, taking the TVWS channel collision and interference into consideration. The simulation results show the collaborative mechanism is well aligned with the model analysis.

articleTitle: A Certificate Life-cycle Management System Based on Blockchain in 5G
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Currently, there are a large number of certificates need to be authenticated in 5G. However, most telecom operators are not ready enough for this. We present a certificate life-cycle management system based on blockchain PKI to solve the problem of identity authentication of base stations. We give a system model based on SM2 and commitment based on SM2. In the system, the certificate authority (CA) detects the service capability of 5G RAN, generates certificates, issues to users, and stores them on the blockchain. The CA can extract certificates from the blockchain. Besides, users in the system can verify the validity of certificates on the blockchain. What is more, they can know exactly whether a certificate is a new one or not according to the certificate pointer. We implemented a prototype, and analysis shows that the blockchain PKI eradicates the problem of single point failure and slow response. Besides, it has a good security, privacy protection, and highly efficient.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Rendering Model in Stereo Display
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In a large-scale stereoscopic environment, the virtual objects are usually compressed into the 3D comfort zone, which results in the poor depth perception of a viewer. To get better depth perception, a hybrid rendering model is presented. The model uses a depth mapping method to provide maximum perceived depth in the region of interest without causing the viewing discomfort. At the same time, it uses a Gaussian fuzzy stereoscopic method or a single viewport non-stereoscopic method in the non-region of interest to reduce the 3D viewing discomfort for excessive parallax. Experiments show that the hybrid rendering model can optimize the stereoscopic virtual space and make the viewer's perceived depth better in a marine simulator scene.

articleTitle: Research and Application of AVC Sub-station System of Phase Modulator in High Voltage Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of long-distance HVDC transmission, the problems of insufficient dynamic reactive power reserve and low voltage quality in some areas have become increasingly highlighted. In order to improve the level of regional dynamic reactive power reserve for converter station, optimize the voltage stability of power grid, and further improve the effect of phase modulator application in converter station, an improved control method of AVC substation is proposed. It optimizes the traditional control strategy, and makes full use of the characteristics of large capacity and fast response speed of the phase modulator. Fast voltage recovery in transition process and reactive power optimization in steady state process can improve the level of voltage stability and the ability of direct current power transmission.

articleTitle: Identification and Robust Control for The Micro-hand Systems Using Robust Right Coprime Factorization Method
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the existing Micro-hand model study, the rubber radius r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> is a fixed value, but the rubber radius r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub> is time-varying, which needs identification. Thus, in this paper, the least squares identification algorithm is used to estimate the value of r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub>. Then with the estimated value, the robust right coprime factorization combined with adaptive control are proposed to deal with the robust tracking issue, which is verified by the simulation result.

articleTitle: The Pseudo-code representation of Test Resources and Test Requirements in ATML
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The ATML documents are used to describe test information and are represented in XML format. We can consider using computer to automatically identify and extract relevant test information in the document, based on which the test program of the test system can be automatically generated. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the documents that representing the elements of the test system to determine the pseudo-code representation of these elements, so as to facilitate the automatic generation of test programs. This paper analyses the test capability of test instruments in ATML test description document and the test requirements of UUT, as well as the cable connection between ATE, ITA and UUT. On this basis, the data structures of connectors, ports, resources, switches, capabilities and cable connections are defined, which lays the foundation for automatic generation of test programs.

articleTitle: The Application of Wavelet Filtering in the Dynamic Loading Identification System of Rock Roadheaders
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: On the basis of wavelet transform theory and method, wavelet transform is applied to filter the cutting head vibration signal and cutting motor current signal for tunneling dynamic load identification system. Wavelet filtering uses wavelet domain threshold filtering method. The method and principle of threshold filtering are introduced, and the selection method of wavelet base is proposed. It is verified and practiced in Matlab and the simulation results show that the time-frequency localization property of wavelet packet threshold denoising can filter a large amount of background noise in non-stationary signals. The signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) after denoising is obviously higher than that of Fourier filtering, which fully demonstrates the superiority of wavelet packet threshold method in non-stationary signal denoising.

articleTitle: Application of Finite Element Method to Three-dimensional Electric Field Computer-aided Simulation of UHV Wall Bushing
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The ±800kV UHVDC wall-piercing bushing is the important equipment in ±800kV UHVDC transmission project in China. It is urgent to simulate and analyze the three- dimensional E-field of its key parts by using the finite element numerical calculation technology to determine the rationality of the traditional structure design and provide an optimization scheme. The actual working environment and rated operating parameters of wall bushing in converter station are analyzed. The three-dimensional electric field distribution of two kinds of the underpass wall bushing structures is simulated by finite element method. The electric field distribution characteristics of the metal shielding surface and its related accessories are analyzed. Three-dimensional solid model electric field analysis of middle connection structure of the bushing and the actual size of the supporting insulator is further carried out, and the structural type and size of supporting insulator are optimized. The results show under epoxy impregnated paper capacitive core structure, potential and electric field distribution along surface of the composite insulator through the wall and sleeve are relatively uniform, and the compact structure design of the sleeve can be realized. For the metal shielded core structure, the high field strength area is concentrated on the surface of metal shield and the external corona equalizing ring. Based on simulation results, ±660kV shrinkage wall-piercing sleeve has been developed and feasibility of ±800kV wall-piercing sleeve has been proved by all types of tests. The research results in this paper provide theoretical basis for design, development and operation of UHV wall bushing.

articleTitle: Study on online monitoring corrosion rate prediction based on GASVR
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Corrosion rate on-line monitoring technology can directly reflect the changes of various corrosion influencing factors, and quickly obtain the corrosion state of media, which is widely used in refining and chemical industry. In this paper, a corrosion rate prediction method based on sequential corrosion rate data is proposed in order to realize corrosion early warning and optimize the amount of anticorrosion injection to achieve better economic benefits. By comparing a variety of time series data prediction models, this paper selects the Support Vector Regression (SVR) for modeling and prediction, and the prediction results achieve good prediction of corrosion trend and realize the corrosion early warning. In order to further improve the prediction accuracy, the Genetic Algorithm (GA) is used to find the optimal modeling interval, then the GA-SVR sequential corrosion rate prediction model is established. Compared with the single SVR prediction, the optimized model has obvious advantages which improves the accuracy of prediction results. Finally, the procedure of corrosion early warning and anticorrosion injection amount optimizing based on Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) is proposed and tested by using corrosion rate prediction model, which achieves good optimization effect.

articleTitle: A Cognitive Analysis on the Difference of Satisfaction of Elderly Residents to Community Health Information Service
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>Objective: To explore analysis of satisfaction and cognitive status of elderly residents to community health information services, and provide a basis for better information service for the elderly residents. Methods: Questionnaire survey was adopted to investigate and analyze the elderly residents over 60 years old. Results: It was found that there was a great difference in the satisfaction of community health information service among the elderly residents.The higher the age, the lower the satisfaction of community health information service; Elderly residents generally have a low cognition of community health services. Conclusion: It is necessary for community health service institutions to provide targeted health information services to different elderly people, so as to increase the publicity of community services and improve the efficiency of utilization.

articleTitle: Sentiment Orientation Classification Method and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The traditional text categorization method, in the word segmentation stage, focuses on the vocabulary discrimination ability, ignoring the people's viewpoints and tendencies from the text, resulting in limited performance in terms of classification accuracy. Because the user's expression has strong correlation with his own emotions, using the scores and comment data of Douban movies and TV dramas provided by Datatang as the corpus, the feature word extraction methods such as chi-square test and information gain are adopted. Combining naive Bayes, N-Gram and support vector machine text classification methods, construct an emotional orientation classification model and experiment with the actual movie forum review data. The results show that the improved classification method can achieve higher classification accuracy, which makes it suitable for a large number of Chinese text emotion classification application systems.

articleTitle: Network Quality Assessment and Optimization Method for Terminal Communication Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Network quality assessment is an important means to optimize network topology, reduce network construction costs and improve network operation quality. For the network quality assessment, most of the existing evaluation index systems are only for the two layers of the physical layer, the network layer and the business layer, and there is no comprehensive evaluation method covering three levels. In order to solve the above problems, the key indicators that affect the reliability of the service are firstly analyzed in depth. Secondly, the network quality assessment model is established, and the weight of the indexes is obtained by using the neural network algorithm to achieve a comprehensive and effective evaluation of the optical network. Through simulations, the proposed Network quality assessment and optimization method can improve the utilization rate of optical cable resources and the ring-forming rate of the site, reduce the network construction costs, ensure the network reliability, and improve the working efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Information Transmission in Blockchain Community Network
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on the tags, this paper divides the blockchain community network into different subgroups, focusing on the information dissemination characteristics of subgroup network users. This paper analyzes the information distribution characteristics of blockchain subgroups by studying the user distribution, the amount of user posts and the distribution of user reputation values. The steemit data is obtained by the way of crawling. Through the social network analysis method, the structural characteristics of the subgroup network are studied. We find that the distribution of subgroup users of the blockchain community network obeys the power law distribution. The blockchain community network is a scale-free network. The distribution of the posts of the two subgroups is similar. And the reputation distribution of the two subgroups is also similar.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization of power system based on dynamic Multi-subgroup differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The power system reactive power optimization model mainly establishes a model to reduce the line active power loss as an indicator. The model is established with the least active power loss, the highest voltage stability margin and the smallest voltage deviation. Aiming at the shortcomings of differential evolution algorithm which is easy to fall into local optimum, this paper proposes to apply dynamic multi-subgroup differential evolution algorithm to power system reactive power optimization. The dynamic subgroup partitioning feature of the algorithm improves the global search ability, and increases the polymorphism of species during the iterative process. The dynamic multi-subgroup differential evolution algorithm and differential evolution algorithm are substituted into the power system IEEE-14 nodes for simulation comparison, and the feasibility and superiority of the algorithm are verified. Comparing the simulation diagrams of the two algorithms, it can be seen that the dynamic multi-subgroup differential evolution algorithm has significant advantages in power system reactive power optimization.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Electromagnetic Assisted Launch Technology for Two-stage Orbiting Launch Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on the research and feasibility analysis of the launch vehicle's electromagnetic assisted technology, this paper takes the two-stage launch vehicle as the research object, and aims to improve the carrying capacity of the launch vehicle. The results show that the medium-sized rocket launches at an initial velocity of not less than 2.26km/s when the electromagnetic assisted launch, the two-stage orbital scheme is feasible; and the large-scale rocket can achieve two-level orbiting without adding the electromagnetic auxiliary launching link.

articleTitle: Robustness Verification Boosting for Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Deep Neural Network (DNN) is a widely used deep learning technique, and ensuring the safety of DNN-based systems is a critical and challenging problem. Robustness is an important safety property of DNN. However, existing work of verifying DNN's robustness is time-consuming and hard to scale. In this paper, we propose a boosting method for the falsification in DNN robustness verification, which aims to find counter-examples earlier. Our observation is that different inputs to a DNN have different possibilities of existing counter- examples around them, and in particular, the input with a small difference between the largest and the second largest output vaines tends to be the Achilles heel of the DNN. We have implemented our method and applied it on two state-of- the-art DNN verification tools and four DNN attacking methods. The results of the experiments on two benchmarks indicate the effectiveness of our boosting method.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization Design of Vehicle Stability Fuzzy Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to ensure vehicle driving stability during critical and dangerous conditions, a new vehicle stability control strategy is proposed, which is to generate compensating yaw moment by using the combined action of active rear-wheel steering and differential braking. Subsequently, the corresponding fuzzy controller is designed to achieve this thought. Furthermore, the genetic algorithm is used to optimize this fuzzy controller so as to improve the performance and overcome the subjectivity in the division of membership functions and the definition of controller parameters. The numerical simulation tests are performed in critical condition by means of the vehicle dynamic model and the virtual prototype model. Simulation results show that the designed fuzzy controller can efficiently prevent vehicle from losing stability in danger.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis and Optimization Ideas on Present Operation Situation for Shanghai Metro Line 6
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Shanghai Metro Line 6, which connects the north and south part of Pudong New District, is recognized as the main public transportation arterial in related area. Present operation situation of Shanghai Metro Line 6 is difficult to meet the travel needs of citizens, for tidal passenger flow is always in its ever increasing process and the marshalling length and the number of rolling stocks available are restricted. Till now, even if there are some related research on operation situation analysis for urban rail transit lines, comprehensive study from multiple angles such as the status of stations, trains, speeds, stopping times is still rare. In this paper, based on the background of Shanghai Metro Line 6, a comprehensive analysis on its present operation situation has been done, several important factors including signalling system configuration, average station spacing, train types and train performance, stopping times and durations have all been taken into consideration during the analysis process, and some optimization ideas for operation based on the analysis has also been given.

articleTitle: Some Fixed Point Theorems in Partial Cone Metric Space
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to verify that some fixed point theorems are valid in the the partial cone metric space. Some fixed point theorems in the cone metric space and partial metric space are extended into partial cone metric space by constructing sequences and iteration, getting some new fixed point results.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Mobile Application for Elevator Balance Coefficient Detector
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Existing elevator balance coefficient detection equipment have some disadvantages, such as the heavy detection host and the inconvenient user terminal. To overcome these shortcomings, portable test host and mobile application are developed for balance coefficient detection. The detection host is based on the principle of "no-load power method", it contains power and speed detection modules. After signal conversion, the data is transmitted to the mobile phone through Bluetooth. The mobile phone application displays the running state of the elevator dynamically, and saves the measurement parameters and calculation results. Through using the portable host and mobile application, the problems of the existing test equipment are solved, which makes the elevator balance coefficient detection more efficient and convenient.

articleTitle: Flight safety risk assessment method for low altitude multi-rotor unmanned aircraft system
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To evaluate the flight safety risk of low-altitude multi-rotor unmanned aircraft system (UAS), a conflict probability calculation method is proposed to characterize the flight safety risk of UAS. Firstly, based on the assumption that the flight error of the UAS conforms to the standard Brownian motion, the flight position prediction model of the UAS is proposed. Then, the flight conflict of multiple UASs is transformed into the flight conflict calculation of a single UAS. Secondly, according to the existing research, a simple analytical method for calculating the flight conflict probability of multi-rotor UASs is obtained. The validity of the obtained analysis method is then verified by simulation. The flight conflict probability between two UASs at different time intervals and different effective avoidance time is calculated and displayed using graph. The analysis and simulation results show that the proposed flight conflict analysis method can clearly characterize the flight collision probability between different UASs, and is suitable for the flight safety risk assessment of multi-rotor UASs.

articleTitle: A Requirement Description Specification for Automatic Customization of Data Products
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of understanding and realizing requirements in the process of data product customization, this paper proposes a data product customization method based on specification requirements description. According to this method, data product requirements are firstly proposed according to the specification, and then data schema mapping is automatically constructed based on the requirements, so as to carry out data product production automatically. In this paper, several important links of this method are described in detail, including the custom requirement description specification, the data schema mapping method based on requirement description and the production of data products based on schema mapping. The result show that this method is feasible for relational structured data and can obviously save the development cost of customized software for data products.

articleTitle: Research on Core Algorithms of 3-D Aided UHV Transmission Line Selection Design Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: UHV power transmission lines are playing very important role in the UHV power system, and the design of transmission line selection is the leading part of the power transmission line project, which is playing a most important role. The rationality of transmission line design impacts cost, difficulty and security of the whole UHV project construction, also impacts overall benefit of power transmission project. Furthermore, it also impacts the whole planning of grid system and country’s security and stability. Along with the development of data gathering technology and hardware of computer, 3-D Aided UHV transmission Line Selection Design Platform (based on 3-D topographic data and 3-D device modeling data,) is already available from both theoretical and technology prospect. And its most key point is the algorithm of 3-D visible Aided transmission Line Selection Design Platform, this paper investigates the algorithm related researches, also includes the technical selection of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of the Shift of Production Center of Seaports on Urban Spatial Forms
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As an important node for the distribution of world-class logistics, the highly developed seaports have large scales in their own yards and warehousing facilities. At the same time, a large number of large-scale port-based industries are gathered in the rear, squeezing each other's development space with the city, and the conflict is particularly sharp in terms of land use. Under this circumstance, more and more cities have chosen to construct new ports in other locations to shift the focus of production of their ports. This paper explored the driving factors affecting urban land use change through GIS, and compares the shifting direction of the gravity center of urban land use in different periods and scale after the port migration, so as to provide references in the selection of the future location of the port city and the integration of land resources.

articleTitle: An Object Detection Algorithm Based on Improved Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As the state-of-the-art in single-stage detector, Yolov3 has been widely used in pedestrian detection, road signal sign detection, face detection and other fields. Although Yolov3 has higher performance compared with other singlephase detection models, its detection speed still has greater room for improvement compared with some lightweight network models. To further improve the detection speed of Yolov3, we have taken the following measures. First, we changed the original feature extraction network to extract feature images by using depth separable convolutions and convolution kernels of different sizes. Then we changed the measurement criteria of the original bounding box. And in order to predict the position of the candidate box more accurately, we used the improved NMS algorithm and upgraded the loss function of Yolov3. Finally, we trained and tested our model using the datasets VOC2007 and COCO2014 under the Tensorflow. Experimental results demonstrate that the presented method can effectively improve the speed of detection while ensuring the accuracy of model detection.

articleTitle: Research on Data Visualization and Application
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The process of data visualization mainly includes three stages: data analysis, data processing and data generation. Data analysis establishes the source of the data and the corresponding industry background; data processing regulates the relevant data, and its content mainly includes three processes of data cleaning, data specification and data storage; data generation is data visualization, usually with some tools to generate various Charts, enabling dynamic interactions, maximize the value of your data. Currently, Data visualization has different levels of application in all walks of life, and the application of stock market data visualization provides a clearer basis for analyzing stocks.

articleTitle: Joint Sensor Energy Conservation and Mobile Sink Cooperation for Data Collection in WSNs
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Data collection is an important issue in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In literature, a large number of existing studies have been proposed. These studies can be further classified into two categories: static sink and mobile sink. In the studies of considering static sink, sensors transmit their readings in a multi-hop manner which leads to the energy unbalanced problem because that the sensors closer to the sink have heavy forwarding loads. To cope with this problem, some other studies adopted mobile sink to visit some collection points which are selected from sensors. All the other sensors transmit their data to the collection points and the collection points directly transmit data to the mobile sink when they are visited. However, most of them considered a mobile sink which constrains the number of visited anchors due to limited path length. This paper considers multiple sinks and explores the cooperation opportunities among the mobile sinks, aiming to prolong the network lifetime of the given WSNs. Performance experiments show that the proposed mechanism outperforms the related studies in terms of energy consumptions of sensors and efficiency index.

articleTitle: Research on Network Attack Detection Technology based on Reverse Detection and Protocol Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the security of Internet information system has become an urgent problem to be considered in the process of Internet development. In order to prevent the computer information system vulnerability, which may lead to hacker attack or virus attack, an active defense idea is proposed. That is to do not open source code and network protocol Trojan horse program vulnerability mining and paralysis attack. There are also many methods to detect network attacks. This paper introduces the research on network attack detection technology based on reverse detection and protocol analysis. By monitoring the network attack packets in the big data environment of power system, the attack packets are restored and analyzed to quickly diagnose and locate the network attack. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can quickly and accurately locate the network attack, analyze the attack process in detail, and find out the specific attack path and attack behavior, effectively ensuring the safe and stable operation of the company's information system network.

articleTitle: A New PAPR Reduction Method for Multicarrier Faster-than-Nyquist Signaling with Selective Mapping
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Multicarrier faster-than-Nyquist signaling (MFT-N) is a promising transmission scheme for future communication, since its high spectral efficiency. However, same as other Multicarrier modulations, MFTN exhibits a high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). Therefore, the PAPR problem in MFTN signaling system is a meaningful topic. In this paper, we propose a new PAPR reduction method for MFTN based on selective mapping (SLM). The proposed SLM method reserves multiple phase rotation vectors in each stage, and choose the signal with lowest PAPR for transmission. The new SLM method shows better proformance while almost without computational complexity increase.

articleTitle: A Novel Fourth-order Adaptive Differential Microphone Array Beamformer for Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Differential microphone array (DMA) has attracted wide attentions due to its high directivity and small size, however, its poor robustness seriously hampers its applications. In this paper, we develop a novel fourth-order adaptive differential beamformer using a small microphone array for speech enhancement. First, by a use of the two existing differential beamforming algorithms, a new beamformer that improves its robustness while ensuring its high directivity is developed. Second, an improved adaptive noise canceller (ANC) is used to further improve the spatial directivity. The improved ANC consists of two novel blocking matrixes (BMs) and a frequency NLMS adaptive filter with a weight coefficient update control mechanism. One of the novel BM is designed to cancel residual interference by compensating interference loss at low frequency part, while, another is exploited to calculate the control mechanism using fourth-order DMA method. The control mechanism is realized by a signal-to-interference (SIR) ratio. The simulation results show that the proposed method effectively suppresses the noise while ensuring the integrity of the target signal.

articleTitle: Study on Data Transmission within ZigBee Network for Outdoor Exercises Group Training
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Within wireless cooperative ZigBee network for outdoor exercises training, athletes interact frequently on a heavy data traffic link. To ensure the network quality and training safety, efficient network data organization and transmission coordination mechanism is one of the key problem of the whole network. In this paper, the data packet structure, data compression method and optimization strategy for data transmission link relay within a outdoor exercises ZigBee network were studied. Network data transmission early preliminary test showed that, the network operated perfectly and satisfied the the requirements of field training under the condition of transmitting and receiving data at a rate of 100 nodes and 1Hz.

articleTitle: Feature Points Extraction Based on Line Fitting for Power Distribution Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: During inspection and operation tasks in the power distribution room, it is necessary for unattended robots to have the ability to acquire high-precision position and attitude information of each distribution switch. For the common square distribution switch, this paper proposes a highly versatile and high-precision feature points extraction method, which can be used for positioning the switch in three-dimensional space. This method combines the classification advantages of machine learning with the positioning advantages of traditional image algorithms, and obtains feature points for matching with a series of methods such as Hough transform and least squares. The matching feature points obtained by the algorithm are fitted by a large number of edge contour points, thus offering high precision and high robustness. The experiment shows that the precision of calculated switch position based on our method can reach 1.5 mm in translation and 1.5 degrees in rotation, which meets the requirements of unattended robot operation.

articleTitle: Federated Cubature Particle Filter and its Application in SINS/GPS/DR Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A federated filter mixture of cubature particle filter and Kalman filter (FCPF) is proposed for integrated navigation system. In allusion to nonlinear sub-filtering model of navigation system based on multi-information sources, cubature particle filter (CPF) is blend into federal structure framework. Compared with EKF (Extended Kalman Filter), CPF can effectively avoid linearization error and obtain higher precision. Moreover, federal structure can improve the reliability of the navigation system. By taking land vehicle based upon SINS(Strap-down Inertial Navigation System), GPS(Global Positioning System) and DR(Dead Reckoning) as the research object, the application of FCPF could get better navigation results than FEKF.

articleTitle: Deformation Monitoring Method of Long Time Series Interferometry for UHV Power Transmission Towers in Goaf
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Power transmission towers have a strong backscattering property in SAR images. In high-resolution SAR images, the target property of UHV towers is reflected as a series of bright spots and form into bright lines that are wide in range and narrow in azimuth. The power transmission towers can be precisely extracted from high-resolution SAR images by their geometric structures, spatial topological relations, texture features and other information. In this paper, we put forward the long time series interferometry for deformation monitoring of UHV power transmission towers in goafs, and an experiment on the deformation monitoring of UHV power transmission towers in the study area is carried out. The result indicates there are two clear subsidence centers in the study area and the ground subsidence is expected to get worse year by year as new infrastructures are constructed in the study area.

articleTitle: ExPDT: An Extended Pushdown Transducer for XML Stream Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new kind of pushdown transducer ExPDT to do XML data stream evaluation effectively and efficiently for XPath queries with parallel predicates, multilevel nested predicates and predicates with value. Compared with relative researches, ExPDT expands the support of XPath queries, and the experiment shows that it improves the performance of XML data stream evaluation.

articleTitle: Design of Locatable Linkage Security System of intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Design a Locatable Linkage Security System of Substation. Laser ranging technology is used to make alarm locator to realize precise location of intrusion point; A precise video linkage scheme is proposed based on SDK of ball machine; Combine alarm positioner, electronic fence, tweeter, searchlight and ball machine into multi-dimensional security system. The actual operation of the system in the substation site provides a new reference scheme for the development of security around the intelligent substation.

articleTitle: Hybrid System Model Based Fault Diagnosis for Speed and Position System of High-speed Train
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Train control system is a typical hybrid system, where the speed and position of train is closely related to the operation safety of high-speed train. A hybrid system model of train movement is proposed to reflect the characteristics of train control system in this paper. For three types of faults in the speed and position system, an improved particle filter algorithm based on hybrid system model is proposed for fault diagnosis. The simulation results indicate that the fault diagnosis method based on hybrid system model is effective for the speed and position system of high-speed train.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method for On-line Monitoring Data Quality of Substation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper analyses the existing problems in on-line monitoring and data quality evaluation of substation equipment, and proposes a multi-dimensional fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method for on-line monitoring data quality of substation equipment. The evaluation index set of online monitoring data quality of substation equipment with 5 dimensions and 11 secondary indexes is established. The weight is determined by combining subjective and objective methods. The fuzzy transformation is completed based on membership function and a multi-dimensional fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is established. Finally, the evaluation grade of online monitoring data of substation equipment is obtained. Finally, compared with other methods, the validity and accuracy of this method are verified.

articleTitle: Design and Test of the Insulator Detection Robot in 500kV
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Insulators are the easily damaged devices in transmission lines, whose insulation performance needs to be checked regularly. It is of great significance to use robots to replace workers in dangerous live detection. In this paper, a robot for insulator live detection is developed, which can apply voltage to measure the resistance of tension-proof porcelain insulator string and transmit the image, so as to judge its insulation performance. Besides, it can be remotely controlled and walk autonomously to complete the detection of all insulators. The performance of the machine was verified by a 500kV AC test in a high voltage hall. The results show that the robot can correctly identify the broken insulator. A strong electric field occurs at the probe.

articleTitle: Pose Evaluation Method Based on Part-based Hierarchical Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Human body posture evaluation can be applied to many important real-world fields such as sports referee assistance. One of the key challenges is to capture the dynamic changes of human bone key points from the video. In this paper, we propose a new network structure based on part-based hierarchical RNN (PHRNN) [6] to analyze the time series information on key points of bones, which can effectively to extract the temporal features of human pose from continuous video frames. We conduct experiments on our own volleyball data set. The experimental results show that the proposed method is effective against attitude evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the Synchronous Control of the Pneumatic Parallel Robot with Two DOF
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To ensure the horizontal attitude of the end position of the parallel mechanism to accomplish the trajectory planning, the control method of synchronous coordinated motion of two cylinders in the parallel mechanism is mainly studied in this paper, which is based on the structure of the pneumatic parallel robot with two degrees of freedom. Two active cylinders in the parallel mechanism cannot be controlled coordinately because of the compressibility of gas, the variety of the load force of parallel mechanism and the difference of cylinder pressures changing in the motion. The paper uses the fuzzy adaptive PID control algorithm with gravity compensation to control the motion of the active cylinder. In addition, the object-oriented coordinated method is used to control the two active cylinders in the parallel mechanism.The synchronous motion control method based on the pneumatic parallel robot with two DOF lays a theoretical foundation for the study of pneumatic parallel mechanism and then improves the pneumatic parallel robot technology. Firstly, the pneumatic parallel mechanism in this paper is introduced. Then the paper studies on the control method when cylinders swing, which is the fuzzy adaptive PID control algorithm with gravity compensation. In the end, two cylinder coordinated motion control method is researched based on the parallel mechanism.

Author Keywords: Two degree of freedom Pneumatic parallel robot

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of Cable Partial Discharge Signal based on DT-CWT_Hankel_SVD
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to identify the type of cable partial discharge Signal, it is necessary to extract the characteristics of its high-frequency signal. In this paper, we first proceed to analyze signal based on dual-tree complex wavelet transform. Then we use magnitude to build Hankel Matrix when we get complex wavelet coefficient and extract singularity signal by Singular value decomposition(SVD). To accomplish getting and recognizing features of PD, we set maximum singular value, average singular value and information entropy as characteristic quantity to analyze its distribution. The artificially simulated metal powder PD signal and standard PD signal are calculated and analyzed. The results show that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: An Online Monitoring System for Instrument Transformers in Power Systems Based on Wide-Area Synchronous Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to ensure the safe operation of power system and the accuracy and reliability of electric energy measurement, it is of great significance to develop a highly cost-effective on-line monitoring apparatus and evaluation system for the entire power grid. This paper proposed an online monitoring system for instrument transformers in power systems based on wide-area synchronous measurement, in which includes a number of operating equipment in power system, as well as their monitoring devices. The overall performance of various measurement equipment is evaluated using related analytical techniques based on big data technologies.

articleTitle: Research on National Park Education and Interpretation Based on China National Knowledge Infrastructure Visualization Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Education is one of the important functions of national parks while interpretation is the crucial means to realize the educational function of national parks. The study of education and interpretation is of great significance to the development of national parks and the construction of ecological civilization in China. Based on the CNKI literature database, this paper carries out knowledge element retrieval and cross-database retrieval with the theme of national parks, education and interpretation, and makes use of the index analysis and visualization analysis tools provided by CNKI to analyze the search results, such as attention analysis, subject distribution, keyword distribution, co-citation, keyword co-occurrence network, and etc. Based on this, multidimensional qualitative interpretation and research frontier detection of thematic research features are carried out.

articleTitle: Closed Loop Control System of Hydraulic Pressure with the Direct Driving of Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to reduce the reactive power loss and the heat of hydraulic energy system of traditional electrohydraulic servo system, a closed-loop pressure control hydraulic system of brushless DC motor based on the resolver is designed, which is controlled by FPGA and processed by DSP and FPGA. The piecewise variable gain speed regulation and triple redundant pressure decision algorithm are adopted. According to the triple redundant energy pressures, the motor can be controlled in a wide range of speed servo. The motor drives the quantitative pump in variable speed to control the pressure and the flow real-timely and dynamically. It has the advantages of high speed, low weight, high reliability and low energy consumption. It can effectively reduce the energy consumption of the system by nearly 50%, and cut the weight by 20%.

articleTitle: Tracking of Underwater Maneuvering Target via M-SIMMUKF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For localizing and tracking of an underwater maneuvering target by sonobuoys, a novel algorithm is proposed based on the scalar weight interactive multiple model (SIMM) and the unscented Kalman filter (UKF). Firstly, the SIMMUKF algorithm is directly obtained by combining the SIMM with the UKF. However, the filter estimation errors corresponding to each model are assumed to be uncorrelated in the SIMMUKF algorithm. In order to solve this problem, the multi-sensor optimal information fusion under the criterion of linear minimum variance is utilized to correct the estimated probability in the SIMMUKF algorithm. Then, a target motion model probability correction algorithm referred to as Modified-SIMMUKF (M-SIMMUKF) is obtained. The tracking accuracy of the M-SIMMUKF algorithm is higher. Numerical results validated the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the Thermal Insulation Effect and Experiment of Plastic Film on the Lateral Facades of Multi-span Greenhouse in Winter in Urumqi
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the thermal insulation performance of multi-span greenhouse and verify the temperature and light properties of thermal insulation film equipped on the lateral facades of multi-span greenhouse, an experimental greenhouse is designed, in which the shed plastic film used for solar greenhouse covering is hanging on the lateral facades as lateral insulation measure of multi-span greenhouse.The experimental results show that the average temperature of greenhouse with thermal insulation measures is 2.9°C higher than that of the greenhouse without thermal insulation measures during the test period, the average temperatures of greenhouse with thermal insulation measures in daytime and at night on sunny days are 2.2°C and 3.5°C respectively higher than that of greenhouse without thermal insulation measures, while the temperature of greenhouse with thermal insulation measures on cloudy days is always higher than that of greenhouse without thermal insulation measures. The light intensity of greenhouse with thermal insulation measures on the lateral facades is 6.71% lower than that without thermal insulation measures.

articleTitle: Quality Detection and Characterization of Star Label Printing Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper is aimed at the quality of star prints used in the quality evaluation of printing and printout industries. Using digital imaging and image processing techniques, we have established quantitative indicators for the quality of star label printing, including star dark line angle width, the shape and size of the fuzzy area, as well as the fill rate in the star label's center. Through the calibration of the light respond of the digital imaging system, the light reflectance gray image of the star print digital image is obtained, and the mass properties of star prints is quantified by light reflectance. The auxiliary line around the star radiant line is used to automatically obtain the center coordinates of the star image. According to setting light reflectance threshold value, the boundary points on both sides of the dark line of the star label and the angle of the radiate line to the center, the visual resolution boundary between the dark lines in the vicinity of the center of the star label and the degree of color ink fill in the 1 mm radius circle of the center of the star label are determined, which have formed a quantitative quality indicator of the star prints. The application results show that the defined quantitative indicators can reflect the transfer performance of the field and small dots in the printing output process. This method can change the current situation where the star label can only be used for visual observation.

articleTitle: Analysis on Slope Stability of Some Pole and Tower on ±800kV UHV Fufeng Line
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The power transmission lines are distributed widely, stretching long and unbroken, and the poles and towers of power transmission lines are mostly distributed on the mountainous slope, and there is a high risk of instable failure under each kind of extreme condition, which seriously affects the normal operation of the power grid. Reasonable evaluation of the stability of the slope of the transmission line under different working conditions is a prerequisite for scientific disaster prevention and mitigation. In this paper, the slope of the pole and tower of the ±800kV Fufeng line is taken as the object of research. Through the site investigation and indoor and outdoor tests, the rock formation data of the slope and the physical and mechanical properties of the rock and soil are obtained. The working conditions are divided into natural conditions and storm. The ABAQUS software based on the finite element strength reduction method and the SLOPE/W module in GEO-SLOPE based on rigid body limit equilibrium method are respectively used to calculate the slope stability, and the advantages and disadvantages of the two methods are compared respectively. The analysis results show that the slope of the pole and tower of the ±800kV UHV Fufeng line is in an understable state under natural working conditions, and it is unstable under the rainstorm condition, which provides a scientific basis for the evaluation of the risk of the power transmission line tower slope.

articleTitle: Research on Data Processing Technology of Computer Jacquard Knitting Circular Weft Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the current computer jacquard knitting circular weft machine, there is a problem that the pattern data transmission is slow and the accuracy is low. When there is repeated call of the same pattern data, there will be a problem that the fabric structure is different. And the system cannot be woven continuously after power-off. A pattern data research scheme of the computer jacquard knitting circular weft machine is proposed. The solution adopts dual-port RAM technology, FSMC technology and GPMC technology to realize high-speed and accurate transmission of pattern data. In this paper, the power-off technology of the circular weft machine is discussed in depth, and the key hardware circuits and software algorithms are designed. The article deeply studies the knitting process and pattern data information, and customizes the special pattern. The results show that the pattern data processing technology realizes the fast and accurate data transmission, and when the system is powered off, the current knitting information is not lost. This technology improves the stability of the computer jacquard knitting circular weft control system

Author Keywords: computer jacquard knitting circular weft machine

articleTitle: Multiphase Relationship Analysis Based Quality Prediction for Batch Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Batch processes require effective quality analysis and prediction techniques to ensure product quality. In this paper, work has been carried out for multiphase batch processes. According to the characteristics of multiphase batch processes, the most critical phase to the product quality will be identified as well as the key variables. A mean value model of a phase is set up within each phase, and the fitness of the model is used to determine whether the phase is critical. Then the key variables are identified based on the process characteristics in each critical phase. By analyzing the relationship between each stage in the batch process, a quality prediction model, multiphase relationship analysis model for batch process quality prediction is proposed. In this paper, the method proposed is applied to the typical batch process, injection molding process, and the prediction results are compared with the traditional methods. The conclusion is that the quality prediction model based on the multiphase relationship analysis proposed in this paper is more accurate than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on grouped self-diagnosis control of seamless underwear machine solenoid valve
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at actuality, seamless underwear machine has number of solenoid valves control points. Solenoid valve control point has a higher short circuit probability because of the quality problem of Solenoid valve. Through summarizing the performance characteristics and working requirements of each solenoid valve, the paper puts forward a kind of valve group control technology solution based on CAN bus. According to the position distribution of the valve group on the seamless underwear machine, the overall implementation method of the control technology is constructed. The key hardware design and software design are elaborated, and the CAN bus communication protocol is established. In order to avoid the occurrence of situation that valve control circuit is damaged due to short circuit of solenoid valve, a solenoid valve overcurrent protection method is proposed. The article improves the real-time and accuracy of the technology by deeply studying the working characteristics of the solenoid valve control points and combining the test data. The results indicate that this technology achieves the accuracy of the valve control action. At the same time, the safety of the underwear machine control system is improved to meet the seamless underwear machine control requirements for the valve group.

articleTitle: Pricing Model and Simulation Calculation of Marine Heavy Container
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This research aims at solving the problems caused by the surcharge of overweight container. The pricing model of overweight container is put forward, and the pricing problem of overweight container is studied from two aspects. In order to increase the profit of shipping company, the optimal pricing model of overweight container is established considering the logarithmic demand function, and the Lagrangian multiplier method is used to solve the model. Depending on the cross subsidy problem of container liner transportation, this paper analyses the pricing model of overweight container and solves the model by using K-T (Kuhn-Tucker) theory. Based on the comprehensive analysis, it is suggested that the second pricing method should be adopted, because this can not only raise the benefit of shipping companies, but also solve the problem of cross-subsidy in container liner transportation to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Integrated route guidance and ramp metering within MPC framework
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
