abstract: This paper is to present a new integrated traffic control model for urban freeways using model-based predictive control (MPC) framework, where the effect of traffic information on drivers' en-route diversion behavior is explicitly modeled using an adaptive Kalman filtering theory. This captures the effect of traffic information on drivers' real-time en-route diversion behavior, based on on-line traffic surveillance data. The integrated control task is formulated as a dynamic, nonlinear, discrete time optimal control problem with constrained control variables. Feedback control is realized by solving the optimization problem for each control interval over a long future-time horizon. Simulation results for a case study show that the proposed integrated MPC model takes in consideration of the time-dependent traffic characteristics and drivers' actual behavior and can significantly enhance the traffic efficiency and reduce the cost of traffic system.

articleTitle: Research on Displacement Monitoring Technique for Goaf along Power Transmission Line Based on GF-3 Satellite Data
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, two typical demonstration areas were selected in Shanxi Province for deformation monitoring of geological disasters likely to happen to the characteristic power passageways in Shanxi demonstration area with domestic GF-3 SAR satellite data and interferometric SAR technique. A total of fifty-three goafs were found, among which seventeen were in a large size and a few just lie in the zone of the power transmission line. One of the goafs was detailed herein. Ultimately, the feasibility and the application value of GF-3 satellite and microwave remote sensing technique in the field of deformation monitoring of geological disasters in power passageways were verified with the aim of promoting technological advancement in power monitoring, providing new technical means for the safe operation of power infrastructures, improving monitoring efficiency, and lowering monitoring costs.

articleTitle: Research on Waveform Table Compression Algorithm Based on Direct Digital Frequency Synthesizer (DDS)
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Direct digital frequency synthesizer (DDS) requires configuration of waveform data tables of hundreds of thousand or even a few million words. Integrating such a large amount of high-speed ROM with current integrated circuit technology is difficult and uneconomical. In order to reduce hardware resources, this paper proposes an improved parabolic interpolation algorithm, which is a low-power direct digital frequency synthesizer structure, using a smaller lookup table to find the sine function. The algorithm performs interpolation calculation according to four waveform data points near the interpolation interval, and can automatically identify the singularity of waveform and select three different parabolic interpolation algorithms, so as to reduce the interpolation error to the lowest level. The algorithm can obviously reduce the maximum interpolation error for different waveforms containing singularities. The experimental results show that the improved parabolic interpolation algorithm has smaller interpolation error than other algorithms when compressing the same waveform under the same compression conditions.

articleTitle: Conditions of C2 continuity of composite Beta-Bézier curves and convergence of Beta-Bernstein operators
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we discussed the conditions of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup> (i = 0,1,2) continuity of composite Beta-Bézier curves at any degrees by computing the first and second derivatives at the endpoints of Beta-Bézier curve, we also discussed the convergence of Beta-Bernstein operators. Moreover, we gave some examples to verify the theorems in some special cases.

articleTitle: A Novel Strategy of DFIG in the Frequency Modulation for Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The DFIG uses a converter based on space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) to realize the decoupling of electromagnetic and mechanical power, but the DFIG cannot respond immediately when the power grid frequency fluctuates. In order to solve this problem, based on the existing model of the DFIG and its control methods, this paper proposes an additional frequency control link in the active power control of rotor side and make the DFIG's rotor release or absorb part of kinetic energy, which can change the active power output according to the change of the grid frequency, so as to realize the frequency control of wind turbines and increase the equivalent inertia of the power system. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The control strategy can make the wind farm of DFIGs participate in the frequency regulation of power system, and the regulation effect becomes better with the increase of wind power penetration rate.

articleTitle: Innovative Design of Multi-process Fixture for Processing the Spokes
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of spokes manufacturing process, existing problems of spokes processing with the traditional clamping of spokes are analyzed. One kind of multi-process fixture for processing the automobile spokes is designed by innovation, which has a simple, efficient and high precision features. The spokes are positioned by using the bolt hole surface and the internal plane, and clamped fast by using the clamping pin in the bolt hole by means of simultaneous centering clamping, the outside diameter surface. The end face, he center hole surface and the external surface of the automobile spoke are processed by the way of one-time clamping. At the same time, the 3D model of the spokes is imported into Abaqus software for deformation analysis. Through checking the results, its easily deformed place is obtained. Then the fixture structure was optimized. After the optimization of the fixture, the maximum displacement and the maximum equivalent stress of the deformable position are significantly reduced, which improves the quality of the spokes. In the actual production, using effect also shows that the multi-process fixture has an advantage of the simple structure, reasonable design, accurate positioning, reliable clamping and convenient operation. It improves the machining accuracy of the spokes and creates good economic benefits.

articleTitle: The Bézier variant of a new type λ–Bernstein operators
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper we introduce the Bézier variant of a new type λ-Bernstein operators based on parameter λ ∈ [-1, 1]. We establish a global approximation theorem in terms of second order modulus of continuity. We also obtain the approximation of this new type operators for the Lipschitz class functions. Furthermore, we give the rate of convergence for some absolutely continuous functions having a derivative equivalent to a bounded function.

articleTitle: Recurrent Attention Capsule Network for Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The main advantage of convolutional neural networks is the extraction of key local features with strong expression capabilities, and usually requires a large amount of training data to achieve better performance. However, the convolutional neural network ignores the hierarchical relationship between the local features and the spatial structure, which may result in a lower accuracy of text classification. For this problem, a text classification method based on Recurrent Attention Capsule Network is proposed. The proposed method uses the capsule network to obtain the spatial position relationship of local features, and uses the recurrent structure to obtain the context information of the words, and uses the attention mechanism to further obtain more important key features for classification. Compared with CNN network and RNN network in text classification, the experimental results show that the experimental accuracy of the proposed method is better than six benchmark algorithms.

articleTitle: Subjective Complexity Measurement Model for Emergency Repair Based on Improved Weight Support Vector Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To improve the objective complexity's inaccurate and less effective in estimating the time and training requirement analyzing, the subjective complexity is introduced. The external, subjective factors such as environment, personal ability is applied to establish the rush repair subjective complexity measurement model by combing weight with support vector which is called improved weight support vector regression model (IWSVR). To solve this model high efficiently, the genetic algorithm meothod which is crossed and viated by cloud model is introduced. Then, the model is validated by the correlativity between the subjective complexity and personal performance (time). The result proves that both the generalization ability and accuracy are better than normal SVR model in personal time estimating and the subjective complexity is better than objective complexity in predicting the personal performance.

articleTitle: Improved Graph Autoencoder for Network Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Network embedding technology transforms network structure into node vectors, which reduces the complexity of representation and can be effectively applied to tasks such as classification, network reconstruction and link prediction. The most important concern of network embedding is how to retain the local structural features while effectively capturing the global features of the network. In view of the shortcomings of SDNE in weighted and directed network, this paper proposes an improved SDNE model based on node degree. The experimental results show that the improved SDNE model has better effect than the original algorithm with higher computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Network Sliding Mode Tracking Control for a Class of Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Adaptive neural network sliding mode control problem of a class of dynamic systems with uncetain and nonlinear characteristics is studied. Firstly, the RBF neural network and adaptive control are respectively applied to approximate the uncertainty part of dynamic systems and to estimate the external disturbance part of dynamic systems. Then, by combining the Lyapunov stability theory and sliding mode control theory, an adaptive neural network sliding mode tracking controller is designed such that the state trajectories of the tracking error system can be driven onto the sliding mode surface, and the asymptotic convergence of the tracking error is guaranteed. Finally, a simulation example verifes the effectiveness of the developed control approach.

articleTitle: Research on Reciprocation and Control System in Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of the sonar system with the unmanned ship as the working platform in the dynamic environment of the ocean, the tension cable feedback of the winch cable is introduced through the research on the hydraulic winch control system and the analysis of the heave motion of the unmanned ship. The relationship between wave height and the unmanned ship's heave amplitude and cable tension is analyzed to obtain the mathematical relationship between the heave amplitude and the cable tension. The lift range of the unmanned ship is expressed by the cable pull force. Therefore, a feedforward- feedback control algorithm based on PID is proposed. According to the variation of cable tension, some cables are released or tightened to ensure the normal operation of hoisting sonar. The simulation results of matlab/simulink are used to verify the control effect. Compared with the traditional PID closed-loop control method, the results show that the feedforward-feedback algorithm can keep the tension within a certain range and can quickly eliminate the interference. The effective control rate can reach 98.33%. It proves that it has better control ability than the closed- loop PID algorithm.

articleTitle: State prediction of centralized protection measuring and controlling device
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is the key to ensure the sustainable operation of intelligent substation to accurately predict the effective life of centralized protection measurement and control device in intelligent substation. A life prediction method based on cloud model and Markov chain is proposed. The initial state probability distribution vector is constructed by using the operation state data of the centralized protection measurement and control device and the membership function of the cloud model, then the state transition probability matrix is obtained according to the Markov chain principle, and the effective life of the protection device is predicted by the reliability criterion. The result of calculation example shows that the method can scientifically predict the effective life of the centralized protection measuring and controlling device, and can provide guidance for the status maintenance of the intelligent substation device.

articleTitle: Power Grid Stability Identification Based on extreme Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of economy, the power grid structure becomes more and more complex, and many new business scenarios and new requirements has emerged. The power system stability analysis method based on physical model was unable to accurately model the uncertain factors in the power system, which make difficulty to analysis the system. In this paper, a method of grid stability identification based on XGboost method has been proposed, and the state of power grid was determined from the grid multidimensional operation data. Firstly, the decision tree method was introduced. Secondly, introduced the principle and characteristics of classification and regression tree, and then introduced the XGboost principle and characteristics. Finally, the IEEE39 node system has been used to verified the correctness of the XGboost.

articleTitle: Second Order Sufficient Condition of Major Constraint Programming
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Second order optimality condition of major constraint programming is researched. Using the structure representation of major constraint set for this programming problem, a second order sufficient optimality condition of major constraint local optimal solutions is given. The result is very useful for the further study of its theory and the design of its numerical methods.

articleTitle: Experiment and Analysis of the Influence of Interferencefrom Distribution Switch Operation on Communication in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Intelligent devices based on Internet of Things technology has more and more applications in the power grid. However, the development of the integration of primary equipment and secondary equipment causes the secondary intelligent equipment to be vulnerable to electromagnetic interference generated by the primary equipment. In this paper, electromagnetic interference generated during the distribution switch closing the capacitive load was measured and the frequency band distribution of electric field interference and magnetic field interference was studied by wavelet analysis. By comparing the frequency bands of common communication signals used in smart grid and the interference signal, it found that the interference signal may interfere with the normal communication work in the smart grid.

articleTitle: A fast and robust image registration algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: An image registration algorithm combining with local regions and feature points is put forward. An improved zero-crossing edge detection replacing Laplace-of-Gaussian operator with Mexican-hat wavelet is carried out to achieve local regions of image and preliminary registration is conducted. Relying on the feature extraction method for Mexican-hat filter response in different scale space, feature point extraction is conducted. Finally, the transformation matrix is achieved by grouping these feature points according to regions for registration and choosing the best registration result from each group, the strategy of the matching process is named grouped sample consensus. Combined with the advantages of the two methods, registration efficiency is improved on the basis of guaranteeing the precision.

articleTitle: Multi-Period Reactive Power Optimization of Distribution Network Considering the Output Characteristics of Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the gradually increase of the distributed generation (DG) in the distribution network, the impact of its output characteristics on the operation of the distribution network is gradually increasing. The distributed generation supply is usually formulated as a constant power model in the problem of reactive power optimization; However, as the injection power of DG varies with the nodal voltage, it is difficult to obtain the optimal solution in actual operation. A reactive power optimization method that considers the output characteristics of the distributed generation supply is proposed in the paper. Aiming at the problem that the genetic algorithm is easy to fall into the local optimal solution when solving the problem, the multiple population genetic algorithm is used to optimize the solution. Test results on the IEEE33 node distribution system verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Edge Detection Method Based on Multi-Population Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Edge detection is a fundamental problem in image processing and computer vision. Recently ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm has been used in edge detection, most existing ACO-based edge detection methods used single ant population and a fixed number of neighborhood pixels to calculate the gradient in the heuristic information for each pixel in transition probability. Those make the algorithm tend to obtain local optima. To enhance the accuracy of the ACO-based edge detection methods, a multiple-population strategy is utilized in this paper. The artificial ants are divided into two populations to obtain both advantages of global search and local search, one trends to make the ants move around optima to focus on local search, the other population make the ants move sharply from current position to jump out local optima and explore global optima. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Distribution Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Comprehensive Fault Factor
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The fault diagnosis of distribution network is the necessary step to restore power supply. By utilizing fault recorded wave data of electrical information, this article proposes a definition of comprehensive differential current of power line and a fault diagnosis method based on comprehensive fault factor for distribution systems. The short-time Fourier transform is used to obtain the harmonic amplitude to further get the fault factor, which is divided into the lateral fault factor and the longitudinal fault factor, so that the fault line can be selected laterally and the fault segment be located longitudinally separately. The simulation results of the 15-node industrial distribution network show that the proposed method is effective and the fault can be accurately diagnosed under different fault locations and different grounding resistances, including single fault and multiple faults condition.

articleTitle: Multi-stage coordinated optimization of active distribution network with adjustable load and distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: More and more distributed energy resource integrations result in profound changes at the "source" and "end" of distribution networks. Considering the randomness and prediction error of renewable energy generation output, a multi-stage and multi-objective scheduling model of active distribution network is proposed, optimizing the dispatch results of distributed generation and adjustable load in the distribution network from day-ahead, inner-day and real-time, in order to reduce the adverse effects of renewable energy generation on the distribution network and optimize the operation of the distribution network. Simulation results on the IEEE 33 node system show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the disadvantage influences of REG prediction error on distribution network operation and promote REG penetrations.

articleTitle: Coordination Planning of Power Grid Considering Wind Power Consumption and Line Load Balancing
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of intermittence and fluctuation of wind power output and the trend of large scale grid connection of wind power and power grid to assume the function of renewable energy consumption, this paper proposes a multi-objective coordinated planning method based on AP (Affinity Propagation) clustering algorithm combined with improved MPGA (Multi-Population Genetic Algorithm) for power grid considering wind power integration. Firstly, the AP clustering algorithm is used to cluster the typical wind farm operation scenarios. Then, the power grid planning optimization model considering wind power consumption and line load balancing rate is established. Finally, the feasibility and validity of the proposed method are verified in the IEEE 18-bus system.
